profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary:
Looking for challenging, large scale projects. 
Extensive work experience in both Java and C#.
Additional experience in Angular and UI design.
Enjoys collaboration and learning new skills.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Created wire frames and POC for insourcing a social media suite.  I was instrumental in spinning up the team and designing both the front end look and feel and the back end design.

Developed RESTful API endpoints used by multiple teams across multiple countries and business regions.  Created an extensive testing suite to ensure no team's changes affected another.

Provided on call support for production issues and trouble shooting in a US wide application.

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Developer
positions.description:
Worked in a team environment to improve the user interface for the SLIC (Semantically Linked Instructional Content) project
Learned web-development on the job without any prior experience
Project contribution: three semesters

honors.title: Academic Year Academic Distinction
honors.description: This award is given to those who complete 30+ units and obtain a 3.5+ GPA in a given year.

projects.title: GM Austin Hackathon 2015 - Project Kill Switch
projects.description: Utilizing Myo gesture-based computing technology along with the Android platform, helped create a web application which would greatly enhance lab safety within GM by providing an advanced "shut-down" mechanism initiated by a simple gesture from almost any geographical point.

projects.title: Shop Click Drive - Mobile
projects.description: A mobile version of http://shopclickdrive.com using the .NET, MVC, Razor, and AutoMapper technologies. An oracle database is used to store and retrieve the information that is obtained from service calls.
